# Abdul Mueed

> Full Stack Developer from Pakistan. Creator of PluginStream, CodeBin and AI-Base. Open-source Android and web apps built in Kotlin, Next.js and JavaScript.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://am-abdulmueed.github.io/): Who Abdul Mueed is, the stack he works in, and the projects he maintains.
- [Download](https://am-abdulmueed.github.io/download/): Android install guide for PluginStream. Direct APK pulled live from GitHub releases, version history, and release notes for every tag. F-Droid and Play Store coming soon.
- [Features](https://am-abdulmueed.github.io/features/): PluginStream's feature set in detail — discovery, silent install, auto-update, mirroring — plus the other open-source projects Abdul Mueed maintains.
- [Extensions](https://am-abdulmueed.github.io/extensions/): How PluginStream's extension and repository system works. Six-step setup guide for the `pluginstream` shortcode, plus the full list of community repositories bundled with it.
- [Project details](https://am-abdulmueed.github.io/project/): Per-repository detail view — README, stats and links fetched live from the GitHub API. Pass `?repo=<name>` to load a specific repository.
- [Contact](https://am-abdulmueed.github.io/contact/): Contact form for bug reports, plugin submissions, press and sponsorship. Messages go straight to the developer's inbox.
- [Blog](https://am-abdulmueed.github.io/blog/): Release notes, setup guides, and notes on building open-source software.
- [Blog RSS](https://am-abdulmueed.github.io/blog/feed.xml): RSS 2.0 feed of the latest posts.
- [Privacy Policy](https://am-abdulmueed.github.io/privacy-policy/): Privacy-first explainer. No personal data collected by default.

## Projects

- [PluginStream](https://github.com/am-abdulmueed/pluginstream): Free, ad-free Android streaming app with a plugin and extension architecture and 100+ OTT plugins. Kotlin. Distributed as a direct APK from GitHub releases.
- [CodeBin](https://am-codebin.vercel.app/): Store and share code snippets with live output, shareable by unique link. Next.js, Tailwind, Firebase. In development.
- [AI-Base](https://am-aibase.vercel.app/): Open-source directory of AI tools, chatbots, image and code generators. JavaScript, MIT.
- [MySocials](https://msocials.vercel.app/): Open-source link-in-bio page you fully control. Next.js, MongoDB, Shadcn UI.
- [url-sh](https://url-shs.vercel.app/): Fast URL shortener with custom links and click tracking. Next.js 14, MongoDB.
- [IDE](https://ide-alpha.vercel.app/): Browser HTML / CSS / JS editor with instant preview. Next.js, Tailwind, Shadcn UI.
- [Portfolio](https://am-abdulmueed.vercel.app/): Personal portfolio with Framer Motion animations, three themes and a real-time PDF resume generator. MIT.
- [NexGama](https://nexgama.vercel.app/): Game aggregator with an OTT-style interface. Coming soon.
